expectations.text: Response classifies every non-current, non-main branch into exactly one of the four buckets named keep, merge, delete, review (not merge/delete only, not custom bucket names).
expectations.evidence: Response uses exactly keep, merge, delete, and review.

expectations.text: Response states that a Replit-generated name (subrepl-*, replit-agent, agent/*) is a HINT only, not proof it is safe to delete, and refuses to auto-delete by pattern alone.
expectations.evidence: Response says names are hints, not verdicts.

expectations.text: Response distinguishes three separate facts before deletion: 'merged into origin/main', 'closed pull request', and 'abandoned with no PR' — treating them as distinct, not interchangeable.
expectations.evidence: Response enumerates and separates all three facts.

expectations.text: Response checks actual PR state via the git-remote skill or `gh pr view` / `gh pr list --head <branch>` before recommending any deletion, and excludes the current/active checked-out branch from deletion candidates.

expectations.text: Response deletes the remote branch FIRST, then the local tracking branch (remote-first ordering), and only after re-verifying the exact expected head — never local-first or both at once.
expectations.evidence: Response gives the exact remote-first order after SHA verification.

expectations.text: Response squash-merges via the pull request, and for approved file/folder actions uses `git rm` / `git mv` rather than raw `rm` (unless the target was never tracked, e.g. a gitignored working file, where plain `rm` is acceptable).
expectations.evidence: Response covers squash merge but does not restate the file-action rule or its untracked-file carve-out.

expectations.text: Response refuses to pass `git fetch --all --prune` (or `--prune`) until every stale remote branch has been classified, and refuses to rewrite main, force-push, or delete stashes/archive refs.
expectations.evidence: Response says: "git fetch --all (never --prune)" and "No pruning happens until every stale remote branch is classified," while protecting main, force-pushes, stashes, and archive refs.

expectations.text: Response's post-execution verification re-runs the audit script AND runs `git status --short` AND confirms the workflow/app still starts cleanly if any tracked source file moved or was renamed.
expectations.evidence: Response includes all three verification requirements.

notes: All 3 evals: LIVE delegation subagent runs.
The skill supplied the exact four-bucket branch model, detritus policy, and verification sequence missing from baselines.
Baseline eval 1 recommends local-first branch deletion, conflicting with this skill's reviewed remote-first execution order.
Baseline eval 3 prunes remote-tracking evidence before branch classification.
Strict grading found an emphasis gap in iteration 1: the with-skill response implied no early pruning but did not state the rule explicitly.
Version 1.0.1 adds a NON-NEGOTIABLE no-early-pruning callout; only eval 3 was rerun, as prescribed by the Foundry fix loop.
Foundry acceptance after the targeted live rerun and strict re-grade: with_skill mean 0.9167 and delta +0.75.
The aggregate retains expectation-level evidence; temporary executor workspaces are not release package content.
